name: mantara
description: Mantara — Hikayat Dunia Sihir (iOS, Android, web). Sumber modular di src/, dibundel jadi satu file oleh scripts/bundle.js

scripts.icons:all: npm run icons && npm run icons:native
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:run:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run ios
scripts.cap:run:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.qa: node qa/1-smoke.js && node qa/4-saveload.js && node qa/5-a11y.js && node qa/6-lifespan.js && node qa/7-kota.js && node qa/8-world-regression.js
scripts.qa:full: node qa/1-smoke.js && node qa/3-crawl.js && node qa/4-saveload.js && node qa/5-a11y.js && node qa/6-lifespan.js && node qa/2-soak.js 10 130 5 && node qa/7-kota.js && node qa/8-world-regression.js
